findings.text: The docs model card is a product page (specs, features, pricing), not a safety or evaluation report.

source.quote: Our cutting-edge language model for code completion released end of July 2025, Codestral specializes in low-latency, high-frequency tasks such as fill-in-the-middle (FIM) and code generation.

findings.text: The card lists API aliases codestral-2508 and codestral-latest for this Codestral 25.08 release.

Supported product features on the card include fill-in-the-middle (FIM) completions, structured outputs, function calling, predicted outputs, document question answering (QnA), prefix, batching, and chat completions.

notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/codestral-25-08). Product/catalog page only: release date, 128k context, text modalities, pricing, feature list. No Weights table, license, params, risk tiers, safety topics, or numeric eval tables. Speed/Performance are unlabeled visual bars with no numbers, so skipped. Modalities from tooltip labels in page RSC: Text input, Text output (no image). licenses array empty in page payload. Blog link https://mistral.ai/news/codestral-25-08 is seeded as mistral-codestral-2508-blog (separate document/card key); seed-lookup for this card listed only this system-card document, so blog deltas (+30% accepted completions, IF eval, MultiplE) were not included. alsoDocuments empty. No pageCount (web page).
